mapper.select: SELECT dea.id, dea.inventory_id, dea.drug_id, dea.hospital_id, dea.batch_no, dea.expire_date, dea.days_to_expire, dea.quantity, dea.alert_level, dea.status, dea.created_at, dea.updated_at, d.name AS drug_name, d.code AS drug_code, d.spec, d.unit, h.name AS hospital_name FROM drug_expiry_alert dea LEFT JOIN drug_info d ON dea.drug_id = d.id LEFT JOIN hospital h ON dea.hospital_id = h.id WHERE dea.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY dea.days_to_expire ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, inventory_id, drug_id, hospital_id, batch_no, expire_date, days_to_expire, quantity, alert_level, status FROM drug_expiry_alert WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drug_expiry_alert WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
